run_mot_param_search: run multi-object tracking parameter search across all combinations of tracker config values
test_mot_param_search: test the mot_param_search module with a config file, checkpoint, and work directory
build_search_params: build a dictionary of searchable parameters from nested tracker config with list values

summarize_mot_metrics: summarize mot evaluation metrics like HOTA, CLEAR, and Identity from test runner message hub
